headline: BPP on the RoboTwin Same Scene benchmark
not_a_competition_score: This is not a score in either field. The policy was shown the demonstration's frames, action trajectory and proprioception, and was then scored from the identical scene it had been shown. The video-only field withholds the actions and proprioception; the sensorimotor field scores from a different initial state. No field allows this combination — and under Same Scene the demonstrated actions are close to the answer, which is exactly why the video-only field withholds them. The benchmark's own replay oracle wins these scenes by feeding those actions straight back.

demonstration_shown.note: The adapter converts the demonstration to end-effector poses and gripper commands and feeds them to the policy alongside the frames. That is more than the video-only field shows — and more than this benchmark offers the competition at all: the plugin declares only the video_only view, because Same Scene makes the sensorimotor view degenerate.

subject.label: BPP (behavior prompting)
subject.why_not_admissible: It is the sensorimotor field's current genesis policy, and its architecture takes the demonstration's actions as input — which the video-only field has no channel for.

ceiling.label: What the harness itself achieves on these scenes
ceiling.why: The benchmark's replay oracle feeds the demonstration's own actions straight back into the identical scene. It is not an entrant and not a policy: it is the measurement that says these episodes are winnable and the scenes reconstruct exactly, so a zero above means the model failed rather than that the task was impossible. It is also why handing a policy those actions under Same Scene measures copying. Same tasks and same scene seeds as the rows above; the oracle ran under the stock camera profile, so the two runs are not one table and the benchmark says so itself, below.
